Enabled.label: Boolean Toggle
Enabled.description: Choose On or Off. Changes print the configuration.

IntegerValue.label: Integer Input
IntegerValue.description: Enter an integer. Press Enter or leave the field to save.

FloatValue.label: Decimal Input
FloatValue.description: Enter a decimal number without a step restriction. Press Enter or leave the field to save.

IntegerSlider.label: Integer Slider
IntegerSlider.description: Drag to choose an integer in steps of 5. Release to save and print the configuration.

FloatSlider.label: Decimal Slider
FloatSlider.description: Choose a value from 0 to 1 in steps of 0.1.

TextValue.label: Text Input
TextValue.description: Enter up to 40 characters. Press Enter or leave the field to save.

IntegerChoice.label: Integer Choice
IntegerChoice.description: Choose Low, Medium or High. The saved value is 1, 2 or 3.

FloatChoice.label: Decimal Choice
FloatChoice.description: Choose a multiplier. The saved value is the corresponding number.

TextChoice.label: Text Choice
TextChoice.description: Choose a display mode. The saved value is compact, normal or large.

TriggerSomething.label: This is a button
TriggerSomething.description: Print the current configuration without changing any values.
